neighbours.label: the slot naming something as the material a thing is made from: 'as a raw material', 'as their medium', 'feedstock'
fire: The bakery uses spent grain from the brewery as a raw material for crackers.
Many potters use local clay as their main medium.
Natural gas serves as a feedstock for fertilizer plants.
Wood pulp is the raw material for most printing paper.
Some painters use old maps as their canvas and paint over them.
The mill depends on imported wool as its raw material.
Iron ore is the basic raw material of the steel industry.
For the new collection, the designer used discarded denim as her medium.
quiet: The bakery buys spent grain from the brewery every Friday morning.
Many potters sell their bowls at the local market.
Natural gas prices rose sharply at fertilizer plants this year.
Wood pulp prices fell for most printing companies last year.
Some painters hang old maps on their walls for inspiration.
The mill exports most of its wool to Italy.
Iron ore shipments to the steel industry slowed last month.
For the new collection, the designer showed photos from her trip.

notes: Probe: 'as their primary medium' 1.14, 'as a raw material' 0.76, feedstock 0.46, 'is the raw material' 0.35; 'as an energy source' only 0.09, 'ate them raw' 0.003; same-topic rewrites <=0.19.
